name: bisect-gate
description: RETIRED DIAGNOSTIC, excluded from `all` via wip. A bisect step, written to answer one question rather than to guard a behaviour. It has one stored run and has never been green. Still runnable by name if that investigation is reopened. ORIGINAL NOTE: The earlier bisection arm B. Identical to idle-wake except the activation gate's timeout is raised from 60s to 300s. Nothing the app sees changes, so a slow result here means the HARNESS is perturbing what it measures: wait_vlog polls the VM for the whole window, and a 300s budget polls far longer than a 60s one. Worth running even though it sounds unlikely - two of this task's three dead theories came from probe artifacts rather than app behaviour.
